description: This file defines the Model class within the OpenCart system, providing a base class with magic methods __get, __set, and __isset to interact with a registry object. It facilitates dependency management and data storage within the MVC architecture of the platform.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Base class providing dynamic property access to the registry for models in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Model with a Registry object for dependency management.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve an item from the registry, throwing an exception if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a value in the registry.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a registry key exists.
